name: Bug report
about: Something broke while playing — help us fix it
title: ''
labels: bug

---

**What happened?**
A clear description of the bug (what you did, what you expected, what happened instead).

**Your setup**
- Mac model / chip:
- macOS version:
- Silicon Sims version (from the DMG/Release, or commit if self-built):
- Game data source: Complete Collection disc / Legacy Collection (Steam, EA App, Epic) / other:

**Logs**
Attach or paste the tail of `~/Documents/Simitone/game.log` (and the crash log next to it, if one
appeared). Plain text is fine — the last ~50 lines usually contain the cause.

**Screenshots**
If it's a visual bug, a screenshot of the wrong rendering (and of the original game, if you have
one for comparison) helps enormously.

**Did you check PARITY.md first?**
Known gaps (fame career, vacation features, pet AI, Makin' Magic coverage, free-will accuracy,
some neighbourhood management, sound/UI fidelity) are tracked in
[PARITY.md](https://github.com/trinadin/silicon-sims/blob/main/PARITY.md) — if this is a known
gap, it already has an entry there.
